errors.evidence: The description states that the x-axis labels (years) are written at an angle, but they are horizontal in the figure.
The description of the olive green line omits a significant peak that occurs in 2008, where the value rises to approximately 260,000 before starting its decline.

errors.text_span: отчита най-ниска точка от около 10 000 през 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies 2015 as the year of the lowest point for the grey line. The actual lowest point occurs around 2012-2013. In 2015, the value is approximately 30,000, not 10,000.

errors.text_span: задържа в участък без съществена промяна около 90 000 между 2016 и 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the grey line remains relatively unchanged between 2016 and 2021. The figure clearly shows a steady and significant increase during this period, from approximately 50,000 to 120,000.
